---
title: (De)serialization of Julia objects
engine: julia
julia:
    exeflags:
      - --project=environments/Serialize
---

```{julia}
import SampleValues
import QuartoTools
```

```{julia}
mktempdir() do dir
    script = joinpath(dir, "script.jl")
    write(
        script,
        """
        import SampleValues
        import Serialization

        func = x -> x
        table = SampleValues.Table([:a => [1, 2, 3], :b => [4, 5, 6]])
        bitmap = SampleValues.Bitmap()

        Serialization.serialize("from_script.jls", (func, table, bitmap))
        """,
    )
    run(`$(Base.julia_cmd()) --project=environments/Serialize $script`)
end
```

```{julia}
func, table, bitmap = QuartoTools.deserialize("from_script.jls")
```

```{julia}
func(1)
```

```{julia}
table
```

```{julia}
bitmap
```

```{julia}
QuartoTools.serialize("from_quarto.jls", (func, table, bitmap))
```

```{julia}
mktempdir() do dir
    script = joinpath(dir, "script.jl")
    write(
        script,
        """
        import Serialization
        import SampleValues

        func, table, bitmap = Serialization.deserialize("from_quarto.jls")

        is_func = isa(func, Function) && func(1) == 1
        is_table = isa(table, SampleValues.Table) && SampleValues.rows(table) == 3
        is_bitmap = isa(bitmap, SampleValues.Bitmap)

        @show is_func is_table is_bitmap
        """,
    )
    run(`$(Base.julia_cmd()) --project=environments/Serialize $script`)
end
```
